note: PROVISIONAL DEMONSTRATION SET, 60 pairs, generated 26 August 2026. IT PROPOSES AND DOES NOT SELECT. Superseded by docs/methodology/02-pair-selection.md section 5 the moment that section is written. HOW THE UNIVERSE WAS REACHED: every constant-product liquidity pool on Horizon holding USDC was enumerated, 879 of them, and the 60 with the largest USDC reserve were kept. That is a COMPLETE enumeration of one venue and not a sample of it. WHAT IT MISSES, stated because it is not small: an asset with a USDC order book but NO USDC pool cannot be reached this way. Horizon offers no way to enumerate the counterparties of an asset: /trades, /trade_aggregations and /order_book all refuse a request naming only one side, and a full /assets sweep returned 26600 records without leaving the letter A. Closing that gap needs a ticker list from outside Horizon, which is a decision for 02 section 5 and not for this file. THE FOUR BUCKETS ARE MEASURED, THEIR BOUNDARIES ARE NOT METHODOLOGY: deep is a two-sided book under 1 percent spread with at least 10000 USDC pooled, moderate is a two-sided book under 10 percent, thin is one side only or a wider spread, dormant is no order book at all on either side. Those cutoffs were chosen to make the four groups in 10-validation.md section 3 visible, not derived from anything. ASSET TYPE IS READ FROM HORIZON AND NEVER INFERRED FROM CODE LENGTH: yUSDC is five characters and credit_alphanum12. TWO CODES APPEAR TWICE WITH DIFFERENT ISSUERS, EURC and GOLD, and they are different assets. REPRODUCE IT WITH: horizon /liquidity_pools?reserves=USDC:GA5ZSEJY... paginated, then scripts/candidate-survey.sh over the result.
